name: Shadow Boxing
instructions: Stand in a boxing stance with hands up.
Throw jabs and crosses at an imaginary opponent.
Move your feet and rotate your hips.
longevityNotes: Cardiovascular fitness is the single strongest predictor of a long, active life. Regular cardio work keeps the heart, lungs, and brain in shape for decades.
overview: Punching and movement drills without a target for conditioning and coordination.
